import hashlib
import json
import random
import statistics
from pathlib import Path

import chess

root=Path('/workspace/HarbiChess');directory=root/'artifacts/ufuk-all-legal-20261004'
result=json.loads((directory/'result.json').read_text())
rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (directory/'positions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
refs=[json.loads(line) for line in (root/'artifacts/ufuk-policy-target-20261003/positions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
old=[json.loads(line) for line in (root/'artifacts/ufuk-root-budget-20261003/positions.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert result['status']=='completed' and len(rows)==len(refs)==len(old)==128
for index,(row,ref,prior) in enumerate(zip(rows,refs,old,strict=True)):
    assert row['index']==index and row['family']==ref['family']
    assert row['reference_row_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(ref,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
    board=chess.Board(row['root_fen'])
    for move in row['moves']:
        assert chess.Move.from_uci(move) in board.legal_moves;board.push_uci(move)
    assert board.fen()==ref['fen'] and row['moves']==ref['moves']
    legal={move.uci() for move in board.legal_moves};assert legal==set(ref['candidate_scores'])
    for name,arm in row['arms'].items():
        assert arm['selected'] in legal
        assert arm['selected_expected_score']==ref['candidate_scores'][arm['selected']]['expected_score']
        if name=='mcts':
            assert sum(arm['visits'].values())==16 and set(arm['policy'])==legal
            assert abs(sum(arm['policy'].values())-1)<1e-6
            previous=prior['arms']['4']
            assert arm['selected']==previous['selected'] and arm['visits']==previous['visits'] and arm['policy']==previous['policy']
        else:
            count=arm['counts'];assert count['nodes']+count['qnodes']<=100000
            assert count['move']==arm['selected'] and arm['budget_wall_seconds']==row['arms']['mcts']['wall_seconds']
            assert arm['wall_seconds']>=count['wall_seconds']
            assert arm['overshoot_seconds']==max(0,arm['wall_seconds']-arm['budget_wall_seconds'])
            if count['completed_depth']==0:
                assert count['value'] is None and count['root_moves_at_completed_depth']==0
            else:assert count['root_moves_at_completed_depth']==len(legal)
for control,contrast in result['contrasts'].items():
    family=[sum(row['arms']['learned']['selected_expected_score']-row['arms'][control]['selected_expected_score'] for row in rows if row['family']==f)/8 for f in range(16)]
    assert family==contrast['family_effects'] and sum(family)/16==contrast['mean']
    rng=random.Random(20261023);samples=sorted(sum(rng.choices(family,k=16))/16 for _ in range(10000))
    assert contrast['conditional_bonferroni_two_contrast_97_5']==[samples[124],samples[9874]]
    assert contrast['passed']==(contrast['mean']>=.01 and samples[124]>0)
ratio=statistics.median(row['arms']['learned']['wall_seconds']/row['arms']['mcts']['wall_seconds'] for row in rows)
fallback=sum(row['arms']['learned']['counts']['completed_depth']==0 for row in rows)/128
assert ratio==result['median_paired_learned_mcts_root_wall_ratio'] and fallback==result['learned_zero_completed_depth_fraction']
assert result['nn_calls_including_warmup']==result['warmup_calls']+sum(row['arms']['mcts']['nn_calls'] for row in rows)<=3500
assert result['wall_seconds']<=1000
assert result['mechanism_gate_passed']==(all(c['passed'] for c in result['contrasts'].values()) and ratio<=1.05 and fallback<=.02)
for arm,summary in result['totals'].items():
    for key in ('nodes','qnodes','evaluations'):assert summary[key]==sum(row['arms'][arm]['counts'][key] for row in rows)
    assert summary['completed_depths']==[row['arms'][arm]['counts']['completed_depth'] for row in rows]

Exact old-control reproduction is not independent evidence.'}

import json

import chess
import mlx.core as mx
import numpy as np
import torch

from harbichess.backends.numpy_sparse_value import NumpySparseValue
from harbichess.backends.pairwise_network import HarbiChessPairwiseNetwork

from harbichess.chess.encoding import BoardEncoder

root=Path('/workspace/HarbiChess');source=Path('/workspace/work/harbichess/all-legal-pinned')
started=time.perf_counter();torch.set_num_threads(1);mx.set_default_device(mx.cpu)
weights=root/'artifacts/ufuk-sparse-value-sparse-train-20261004/checkpoints/step-001500/model.safetensors'
assert sha256(weights)=='15882e0e9c967f6231aefa0a7121cef8daedd65895b9ee0cb916ac8cab4c93ed'
probes=root/'docs/research/UFUK-width-latency-probes-20261004.json';boards=[]
for row in json.loads(probes.read_text())['positions']:
    board=chess.Board(row['root_fen'])
    for move in row['moves']:board.push_uci(move)
    assert board.fen()==row['fen'];boards.append(board)
x=torch.tensor([BoardEncoder().encode_board(b).values for b in boards]).reshape(-1,8,8,104)
model=load_weights(weights);native=HarbiChessPairwiseNetwork.from_portable(weights);numpy=NumpySparseValue(weights)
with torch.no_grad():expected=model(x)[1].numpy()
mlx=native(mx.array(x.numpy()))[1];mx.eval(mlx)
actual=np.array([numpy.logits(board) for board in boards]);np.testing.assert_allclose(actual,expected,atol=2e-5,rtol=2e-5)
np.testing.assert_allclose(actual,np.array(mlx),atol=2e-5,rtol=2e-5)

directory=root/'artifacts/ufuk-all-legal-20261004';assert not directory.exists();directory.mkdir()
